bio.text: Joaquin Arambula was elected in 2016 to represent the 31st Assembly District in Fresno County; his official biography says he is the first Latino physician elected to the California State Assembly.
He worked as an emergency room doctor in Selma and chaired the Assembly Budget Subcommittee on Health and Human Services from 2016 to June 2023.
Arambula was born in Delano, grew up in Fresno, and graduated from Bowdoin College and the University of Minnesota Medical School.
